{{Quote|Then there was a manumitted destroyer droid, pre–Clone Wars era, named Impaler.|Sharr Latt|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Impaler''' was a fictional pre-[[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Droideka/Legends|Droideka]] devised by [[Wraith Squadron]] leader [[Garik Loran]] as part of a fictional third Wraith Squadron ruse.<ref name="MK" />

[[Viull Gorsat]], a former [[Shamed Ones|Shamed One]] who had joined the Wraiths, recalled that when he was first adopted by his parents, they gave him a toy droideka to help him overcome his fear of machines. The toy would chase [[Insect/Legends|insects]] out of his room and impale litter into waste bins. Gorsat claimed to have named the toy Imapler.<ref name="MK" />
